title: The 9/11 Inversion — Primed False-Flag and Public Rejection
statement: The regime, seeking an emergency exit to compress its failing timeline, will attempt a high-impact manufactured crisis or false-flag event blamed on external Islamic actors—mirrored after the post-9/11 playbook. This is preceded by pre-emptive narrative priming (Crusader imagery and anti-Islam amplification in the absence of an actual triggering event). However, unlike 2001, 25 years of institutional exhaustion, broken Forever Wars, and systemic distrust will cause the American public to reject the narrative, turning the false-flag attempt into a fatal exposure of regime desperation rather than a successful consolidation.

Turnkey surveillance and police-state infrastructure built post-9/11 is already fully in place, ready to be repurposed domestically.
Historic collapse of public institutional trust across military, intelligence, and executive apparatuses, preventing a 2001-style blank-check rally-around-the-flag.
evidence_contradicted: High systemic risk of exposure: a failed false-flag under conditions of high skepticism carries terminal political penalties.
Regime may lean entirely on bureaucratic/Kemalist suppression rather than theatrical violence.
falsifier: No manufactured high-impact false-flag/crisis event occurs within the projected window, AND the public does NOT reject one (the inversion half) - either no attempt is made (regime relies on quieter tracks) or an attempt succeeds without fatal exposure.

title: Cognitive labor reprices first; political instability concentrates in the credentialed middle class
statement: Through 2030, AI deployment will visibly reprice cognitive work (entry-level white collar, junior legal/finance/analysis, routine coding) faster than physical and relational work. The political friction from displacement will concentrate in the credentialed middle class — the overproduced cognitive elite — manifesting as credential-devaluation fights, elite-turned-populist movements, and enclosure battles over who may deploy AI professionally.

title: Recursive acceleration: AI-on-AI-research compresses progress only after 2028, if at all

If super-linear acceleration appears, it appears 2028-2029 at the earliest, and concentrates in software/algorithm domains before physical-world domains.
